## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] MAE and RMSE are scale-dependent and cannot directly compare series with different units. (low confidence) — https://otexts.com/fpp3/simple-methods.html · keywords: Statistical learning and overfitting in trading

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Gu, Kelly and Xiu divide their data into three disjoint time periods that preserve temporal ordering. (low confidence) — https://dachxiu.chicagobooth.edu/download/ML.pdf · keywords: Statistical learning and overfitting in trading
- [statement] In Gu, Kelly and Xiu, the testing subsample is used for neither estimation nor hyperparameter tuning. (low confidence) — https://dachxiu.chicagobooth.edu/download/ML.pdf · keywords: Statistical learning and overfitting in trading
- [statement] In the Gu, Kelly and Xiu specification, lasso induces exact zero coefficients while ridge shrinks coefficients without imposing exact zeros. (low confidence) — https://dachxiu.chicagobooth.edu/download/ML.pdf · keywords: Statistical learning and overfitting in trading
- [statement] A naive forecast sets every future forecast equal to the last observed value. (low confidence) — https://otexts.com/fpp3/simple-methods.html · keywords: Statistical learning and overfitting in trading
- [statement] The mean forecasting method sets future forecasts equal to the historical average. (low confidence) — https://otexts.com/fpp3/simple-methods.html · keywords: Statistical learning and overfitting in trading
- [statement] Lo and MacKinlay reject the random-walk model for their 1962–1985 weekly-stock-return sample; their rejection is not evidence for a mean-reverting price model. (low confidence) — https://rodneywhitecenter.wharton.upenn.edu/wp-content/uploads/2014/04/8705.pdf · keywords: Statistical learning and overfitting in trading
- [statement] In the Costantini, Crespo Cuaresma and Hlouskova EUR/USD study, directional accuracy records whether the sign of the forecast change matches the realized sign and does not account for movement size. (low confidence) — https://pure.iiasa.ac.at/id/eprint/12332/1/Forecasting%20Errors%2C%20Directional%20Accuracy%20and%20Profitability%20of%20Currency%20Trading.pdf · keywords: Statistical learning and overfitting in trading
